Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings here in Dambulla. Harmanpreet Kaur collects the trophy with a big smile and India Women pose for a team photograph. The caravan will now move to Pallekele for the ODI series. The first game is scheduled to be played on Friday, 1st July 2022. It will start at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT) but our build-up will begin a lot earlier. Do join us for all the action. Till then, goodbye and cheers!
Player of the Series award is bagged by Harmanpreet Kaur. She is also handed over the trophy for winning the series 2-1.

Chamari Atapattu, the victorious captain of Sri Lanka Women, is also the Player of the Match. Says that this win is very good for them, as it's a young side and this win will give them confidence. Adds that she tried to control the game with her batting. Mentions that India are a very good side, there is a lot of experience in their camp but feels that the home team lost the last two games because of not doing well at crucial points. She thanks the crowd for supporting her and Sri Lanka Women.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women, says that Sri Lanka deserve this win after the way they batted. Adds that partnerships were there for them but they were looking for a better strike rate. Admits that they need to work on their strike rate with the bat. Mentions that the spectators supported both the teams and they really enjoyed.
Time for the presentation...

India Women were once again not at their best with the bat but managed to get a decent total on the board with Harmanpreet Kaur batting till the end. The Sri Lankan bowlers have bowled well throughout this series and it was the same case yet again but the problem for them has been their batting, which they rectified in this game and notched up a victory to close the series on a high. The Indian bowlers would have fancied defending this total but they gave away too many boundary balls and that never brought any pressure on the Lankan batters. Their fielding too was quite sloppy and in the end, that cost them this game. A series win here for India but they have a lot to ponder about and need to be better with their execution if they want to compete with the best.

Chasing a decent target, Sri Lanka were positive with their intent right from the onset as young Vishmi Gunaratne started off with a boundary and Harshitha Madavi too played some positive shots before both of them perished. However, Nilakshi de Silva joined her skipper, Chamari Atapattu and both of them stitched together a brilliant partnership, scoring boundaries at a brisk rate. We all know, that when Chamari Atapattu gets going it is very difficult to stop her and though Nilakshi de Silva departed in the end, with Chamari Atapattu at the crease, Sri Lanka cruised to a comprehensive victory. The Sri Lankan skipper stayed unbeaten on 80, off 48 balls, and India Women had no answers to the onslaught by the stylish left-hander.

Chamari Atapattu has powered her team to a spirited run-chase here in Dambulla and with that, Sri Lanka Women have registered a rare T20I victory against India Women. The visitors have won the series but were quite sloppy this afternoon and Sri Lanka made them pay for it. Just what Sri Lanka Women needed ahead of an important ODI series and this win sets things up nicely for the remainder of the tour.

FOUR! SRI LANKA WOMEN WIN BY 7 WICKETS, with 18 balls to spare! Radha Yadav serves it a bit short and around leg, Chamari Atapattu gets back and nudges it past short fine leg. The fielder gives a lazy chase as the ball races away to the fence. Kavisha Dilhari screams in joy, for the first time Sri Lanka Women have defeated India Women in a T20I game at home!
Fuller and around off, Kavisha Dilhari eases it to wide mid on and rushes across to the other end. A direct hit at the bowler's end would have consumed Kavisha Dilhari.
Put down! Short and wide outside off, Chamari Atapattu cuts it aerially to point where Sabbhineni Meghana fails to catch it over her head. They cross.

FOUR! Misfield in the deep! Flatter delivery, full and around leg, Chamari Atapattu kneels down and powers her sweep shot to deep square leg. The fielder in the deep, Smriti Mandhana, gets across to her left to stop the ball but it bursts through her hands and goes behind to meet the fence.
Quicker through the air, a touch short and around off, Kavisha Dilhari gets back and nudges it wide of short fine leg for one.
Short in length and outside off, Kavisha Dilhari goes on the back foot and slaps it to deep point for a couple of runs. 9 needed more.
Fuller and outside off, Chamari Atapattu hits it firmly to backward point and Smriti Mandhana does well to make the stop, on one bounce.
FOUR! That's in the gap, don't bother chasing. Fuller in length, around middle, Chamari Atapattu leans across and whips it behind square leg for a boundary.
Fullish around leg, Kavisha Dilhari knocks it down to long on for a single.
Around off, on a length, it's tucked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on middle, Kavisha Dilhari flicks it off the inner edge through square leg for a run.
Angles in a full ball, around off, it's defended back.
FOUR! Shot! Yadav fires it full and around off, Chamari Atapattu walks down the track and hammers it to the long on fence. Just 18 needed more.
WIDE! Pushed quicker and down the leg side. Chamari Atapattu looked to clip it but missed.
Full and angling into pads. Kavisha Dilhari works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery on middle. Chamari Atapattu drives it to long on for a single.
Kavisha Dilhari is the new batter.
Back of a length, around off. Chamari Atapattu chops it to point.

OUT! RUN OUT! Simran Bahadur makes amends with a brilliant fielding effort and the partnership is broken as Nilakshi de Silva is short of her crease! This is flatter on middle, Chamari Atapattu works it towards mid-wicket and looks for the second run. Radha Yadav runs all the way towards the ball but at the same time, Simran Bahadur also comes charging in from the deep and fires a good throw at the bowler's end. Deepti Sharma collects the ball and whips the bails off as Nilakshi de Silva fails to make her ground with a dive. The replays confirm the same.
Shout for a run out! It's referred upstairs. The replays find that Nilakshi de Silva is short of the crease. India Women have an opening.

FOUR! Boundaries continue to flow! This is tossed up on middle, Chamari Atapattu slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes aerially in that region and Simran Bahadur in the deep puts in a dive running to her left but fails to stop or catch it and the ball races away towards the fence.
On a length, on off. Nilakshi de Silva blocks it out. India Women need something special to pull this one off now, just 30 needed from 36 balls!
FOUR! Runs are flowing now! Short and wide outside off. Nilakshi de Silva cuts it and cuts it in the gap through backward point for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Chamari Atapattu cuts it to deep point for a single.
Pulls her length back, outside off. Chamari Atapattu looks to punch it but misses.

FOUR! This time she hits it firmly and the ball races away towards the fence! This is full on off, Chamari Atapattu drills it down the ground. It is hit so hard that the fielder at long off has no chance. Sri Lanka Women are bossing this game now!
A fullish delivery, around off. Chamari Atapattu tries to drive but mistimes it towards the off side.
Change in bowling. Renuka Singh is back into the attack. 1 for 11 runs in her 2 overs so far.
Slower through the air, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva looks to drive it away but does not get any timing. 39 needed now from 42 balls!
FOUR! Nilakshi de Silva is playing a fine knock here! Short delivery on off, Nilakshi de Silva goes back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 100 up!
A fuller delivery on off. Nilakshi de Silva drives it back to the bowler.
Beaten again! This is angled around off. Chamari Atapattu gets beaten on the inside edge. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a bye is taken.
This is again pushed quicker and outside off. Chamari Atapattu looks to push it away but misses.
A flatter and quicker one around off. Chamari Atapattu pushes it behind square on the off side.
Will Harmanpreet Kaur continue from this end? Nopes, it's going to be Shafali Verma. Surprised? She bowled two overs in the first match of the series as well and bagged a wicket too.
Another dot to end the over! 44 needed now from 48 balls! This is outside off and a tad short as well. Nilakshi de Silva cuts but mistimes it to point.
A slower delivery that lands on a length, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva punches it to covers.
Back of a length, around off. Chamari Atapattu goes back and pulls it to long on for a single.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off. Chamari Atapattu looks to cut but misses.

FOUR! Fifty for Chamari Atapattu, off just 29 balls. Short in length and outside off, Chamari rocks back and whacks it over backward point. She continues with her good form and Sri Lanka are on track!

FOUR! A tough chance in the deep goes down and the ball races away towards the boundary. This is fuller on off, Chamari Atapattu slog-sweeps it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. Jemimah Rodrigues, in the deep, runs to her left and dives but fails to pouch it and it goes away for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Nilakshi de Silva works it to long on for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Chamari Atapattu punches it to covers. 55 needed from 54 balls now!
Shorter again on off. Nilakshi de Silva looks to pull but gets the inside edge onto her pads. The ball rolls behind the keeper and a single is taken.
Fuller delivery, on off. Chamari Atapattu hits it hard and a bit uppishly towards long off for a single.
Shorter in length, on middle. Chamari Atapattu goes back and makes soom room but cuts it straight to the cover fielder.
This is pitched on off, Nilakshi de Silva skips down the track and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower through the air on off, Nilakshi de Silva goes back and defends it towards the leg side.

Beaten! Extra pace there. A length ball outside off, Chamari Atapattu gets across the line and tries to punch it through covers but misses. At the halfway mark, Sri Lanka Women are cruising. 58 needed more.
On a good length around off, Chamari Atapattu walks across the stumps and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Another wide! One more length delivery goes very wide outside off, Chamari allows it through.
Wide! Simran Bahadur loses the radar and serves a length ball way wide outside off, Chamari Atapattu leaves it.
Fuller and around off, it's dragged down over wide mid on for a run.
Uppish but safe! Full in length and outside off, Nilakshi de Silva is early into her shot and chips it towards the cover fielder. Doesn't carry.
FOUR! Bang! Yet another slower delivery, full and around off, Nilakshi de Silva picks it early and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary. This partnership is running away with the show.
Starts with a slower delivery, full and on middle, Nilakshi de Silva defends it away to mid-wicket.
Simran Bahadur is into the attack now.
Short again, around off and turning down, Nilakshi de Silva moves back and tucks it behind square leg for a run. 10 from the over, 67 needed off 66 balls.

Lovely piece of fielding! Slower again, short and on middle, de Silva goes back and pulls it firmly to deep mid-wicket. Jemimah Rodrigues dives and stops the racing ball. She parries it towards the deep square leg fielder and saves two runs for her side.

Appeal for a run out! Chamari Atapattu jumps down the track to a full ball and pushes it with soft hands to point. The fielder comes up with a direct hit at the keeper's end and they appeal. The replays show that Nilakshi de Silva is safely in.
Tossed up, around middle, played down from the crease to short third man.
Wide! Slower through the air, full and angling down the leg side, Chamari Atapattu tries to sweep but misses.
FOUR! Chamari Atapattu is racing away! Full and flighted, it's darted around leg, Chamari Atapattu goes down and sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Begins her spell with a long hop around off, Nilakshi de Silva goes back and pulls it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur comes onto bowl now.
FOUR! Slapped away! This one is short and wide outside off, Chamari Atapattu latches onto it and slaps it over backward point for a cracking boundary. 9 from the over, 77 needed off 72 balls.
Back of a length, around middle and keeping a bit low, Chamari Atapattu tries to pull but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Short in length and outside off, de Silva cuts it past the diving point fielder for a single.
Fuller and around off, Nilakshi de Silva drives it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
FOUR! Very full in length around off, angling in, Nilakshi de Silva clears her front leg and forces it down to long on for a boundary.
Starts with a full delivery around off, Nilakshi de Silva drives it back towards the bowler.
Pooja Vastrakar is into the attack now.
Gets back and turns it in the gap on the leg side for a single at square leg.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Nilakshi de Silva gets back to defend but it takes the outer half and rolls to the off side.
Arm ball, around off, de Silva gets back and tickles it gently to mid-wicket. She returns for the second run.
Loopy delivery, full and around off, Chamari Atapattu goes down and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a run. She has completed 2000 T20I runs now.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Nilakshi de Silva helps it gently to square leg and takes a run.
Loopy and around leg, it's swept nicely to deep square leg for a single.
Steps down the track and strokes it down to long on for another run. At the end of the Powerplay, Sri Lanka Women are 47/2.
Walks forward and flicks a full ball through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, around middle, defended on the leg side.
Flighted around middle, it's eased down to long on for a run.
Tossed up, outside off, Chamari Atapattu plays it down late to the left of the keeper.
SIX! This one has gone all the way! Full and flighted, around off, Chamari Atapattu runs down the track and lofts it cleanly over long off for a maximum.
Single to end the over! Slower through the air and outside off. Chamari Atapattu drags it down to long on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Radha Yadav strikes and breaks this dangerous-looking partnership! Tossed up on middle, Harshitha Madavi goes for a big slog-sweep this time. However, she does not get enough power behind her shot and finds Smriti Mandhana at deep mid-wicket. She takes an easy catch and India have got a much-needed wicket. Nilakshi de Silva walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and quicker on off. Harshitha Madavi blocks it out.
Fuller on middle. Chamari Atapattu drives it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Chamari Atapattu looks in the mood today! On middle and Chamari Atapattu gets on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. There is big dive from the fielder in the deep but the ball beats her and races away towards the fence.
FOUR! Chamari Atapattu is not going to miss out on such a gift! This is short and outside off, Chamari Atapattu cuts and cuts it hard through point for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle. Chamari Atapattu skips down the track and hits it to long on for a single.
This is quicker, around off. Chamari Atapattu gets across and looks to sweep but misses. A stifled appeal for an LBW but not given.
FOUR! Connects it off the middle this time! It is full and outside off. Chamari Atapattu gets under it and slams it over covers for a boundary.

FOUR! Now, Chamari Atapattu gets into the act! This is tossed up, outside off. Chamari Atapattu goes hard at it as he looks to drive it away. She gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs away towards the backward point fence.
Sharma goes fuller on middle, Harshitha Madavi sweeps it to deep square leg. However, the fielder does well and keeps it just inside the fence with a dive. Three runs are taken.

FOUR! Harshitha Madavi gets another boundary! This is full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi drives it firmly past mid off for a boundary. This will put a lot of pressure away from Chamari Atapattu who is yet to get going!
Bowls it fuller and wider outside off again. Chamari Atapattu lets it go, probably thinking that it will be called a wide.
Short and wide outside off. Chamari Atapattu looks to cut but misses.
A full delivery on middle and leg. Harshitha Madavi flicks it to deep backward square leg for a single.
This is much fuller, outside off. However, Harshitha Madavi again finds the point fielder as she pushes this ball away.
Back of a length, around off. Madavi punches it towards point.
FOUR! Very good shot, this! Singh is a bit short on middle, Harshitha Madavi gets across slightly and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Tossed up on off. Harshitha Madavi drills it to long on for a single.
On middle and Harshitha Madavi pushes it to mid on.

NOT OUT! This is slower through the air, outside off. Madavi tries to drive it away but misses. Yastika Bhatia collects the ball and whips the bails off quickly. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs after an appeal. However, the replays show that Harshitha Madavi's back leg is grounded inside the crease.
Stumping appeal...
A fuller delivery on middle. Harshitha Madavi sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Pitches it on off and it turns away. Harshitha Madavi cuts it to point.
On off and fuller. Harshitha Madavi defends it towards the off side.
Harshitha Madavi is the number 3 batter. And it will be Deepti Sharma to bowl from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant catch from Harmanpreet Kaur and India Women get their first wicket! Fullish delivery on middle, Vishmi Gunaratne looks to loft it away towards the leg side. However, she miscues it and the ball goes in the air behind mid on. Harmanpreet Kaur there runs back, across to her right, covers a lot of ground and takes a fantastic catch in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Lands on a length, around off. Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Good shot! Singh goes fuller and on middle, Vishmi Gunaratne flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

Bit of misunderstanding between the batters but all good in the end! This is fuller on off, Vishmi Gunaratne drives it to mid off. There is a bit of misfield and Vishmi Gunaratne looks for a single but is sent back in time.
Chamari Atapattu is off the mark as well! On a length, on off. Chamari Atapattu defends it square of the wicket towards the off side for a single.
A full delivery on off to start from Singh, Vishmi Gunaratne inside-edges her attempted drive to mid-wicket and crosses for a run.
